# C01 offline protocol fixture

The catalog, zlib 1.3.2 archive, local cache receipt and license notice are retained real source bytes. The archive SHA256 is `bb329a0a2cd0274d05519d61c667c062e06990d72e125ee2dfa8de64f0119d16` (1,502,830 bytes). `inputs/notices/LICENSE.zlib` preserves the upstream copyright, license and notice. Both retained source plans and reviewed maps bind the repository's real C01 baseline/LTO recipes.

The receipt describes local cached bytes. It contains no HTTP response, acquisition timestamp, signed URL or host identity and does not authenticate a new download. Nothing is fetched while preparing or running these tests. The receipt's legal and source-completeness acceptance fields remain false.

Tests copy these files into a temporary private cache and use the repository's real recipe files. The package inventory, image, prerequisite metadata and fake build results are explicitly synthetic host protocol controls. They establish no native build, installed behavior, M2 compatibility, performance or release acceptance. Derived-recipe tests alter only temporary copies.

`fixture-files.json` records the finite retained input set. Its hash is pinned by the fixture helper; each retained file's size and digest is checked before use. No ignored artifact path, environment root override or runtime repository-external input is used.
